snippet.title: Ellsydia - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
The demo for Ellsydia is OUT NOW! 🏡✨

Your cozy village is waiting — download the demo and help it grow with a wishlist! ❤️

🎮 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4159160/Ellsydia

Ellsydia is a casual management and building game where you create a village in a medieval setting with a touch of fantasy. Construct buildings and shops to attract residents and travelers. Upgrade your structures and complete various objectives to make your village a vibrant and welcoming place to live! Keep your villagers happy and watch their lives unfold through the many missions you will encounter.
